purpose: SELV-spine contract between WS4 (drive / bias / monitor / protect islands) and WS5 (SELV side), validation-results/13-coupling/README.md section 8 and section 10 item 1. Checked by gates/spine_lock.py.

reissued.why: PS1 / V15_SELV deleted: J4.1 moves from v15_selv to the single-pin net j4_nc1 (4 pad keys), and the three v15_selv vias in the region are gone, so selv_gnd In2.Cu and v3v3 In1.Cu fill their antipads (2.374 mm2 each). Nothing else in the region changed (chain run 1, spine-lock.json). The baseline is the stage-38 chain-run-1 board 6f080b0d; the final stage-38 board differs from it only outside the region (the N_FILT via at (256.8, 116.6)).
